actual_scope: Exact canonical signed-connector tariff over every nonzero unital coefficient ring, with arbitrary dirty data, uniform linear maps and positive fixed prices equal between signs.
scope_change_reason: The card requests a new priced operation. This side result instead changes the coefficient domain, takes the released characteristic handoff, and proves which arithmetic characteristics preserve or reduce the existing signed-query tariff.
bottleneck_link: Coefficient-domain changes can alter the restoration tariff of recursive connector interfaces; this theorem prevents importing F3 savings into incompatible coefficient rings. No supplier seam or kappa gain is asserted.
stop_rule: Finish the written ring-characteristic proof, its fixed-price envelope and bounded exact controls. Stop before physical supplier expansion.
